thread:
sara: FYI I opened a docs PR to consolidate the Dedicated provisioning playbook + add concrete autoscale examples and a short Terraform + SDK snippet. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

aj: saw the PR. big +1 for examples. one quick question: should the autoscale policy examples include both request-rate and GPU-utilization variants?

sara: yes — I added two small examples: one for steady throughput (min_replicas, max_replicas, target_rps) and one for GPU busy heuristics (gpu_util_target). they're in the examples section.

natalie: wording note: in the SLA section we currently say "SLA-backed latency" which is confusing for Dedicated — suggest: "SLA targets depend on committed tier and topology; consult the Dedicated SLA matrix". also we should add a migration note for customers moving from shared -> reserved pools.

ollie: can we include the isolation decorator example you mentioned last week? customers keep asking how to guarantee single-tenant eviction boundaries.

sara: added a short isolation example and a note about eviction precedence. excerpt: ```yaml
isolation: 
  reserved_pool: true
  eviction_policy: "isolate-first" # prefer eviction from non-reserved tenants before this pool
  annotations: ["pci", "sensitive-data"]
```

aj: nice. small nit: in the Terraform snippet, the resource name leaked internal field names. i prepared a tiny replace to use the public API fields. use this snippet instead: ```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "customer_a" {
  name        = "customer-a-reserved"
  region      = "us-west-2"
  min_gpus    = 2
  max_gpus    = 8
  autoscale {
    mode = "target_util"
    target_gpu_util = 0.7
  }
  isolation_tags = ["team:payments", "env:prod"]
}
```

deploy-bot: CI/checks for PR #482 started — docs lint OK, link-check failing (404) on the legacy provisioning link.

natalie: I can fix the link. which href is 404?

sara: it's the old "reserved pool lifecycle" link under /internals/provisioning. i swapped it to /dedicated/provisioning/lifecycle. also added a small migration checklist: - export pool config - map labels -> isolation_tags - validate quota and rollback plan

ollie: could we add a short SDK snippet for the python client to create a pool? customers often ask for that. something like: ```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.create_pool(name='customer-a', region='us-west-2', min_gpus=2, max_gpus=8, autoscale={'mode':'target_util','target_gpu_util':0.7})
```

aj: that looks good. maybe mention that create_pool is async and returns an operation id to poll. also call out IAM roles required for private deployments.

sara: added both notes. final TODOs before merge: @natalie update SLA phrasing + link fix (in progress), @aj review Terraform snippet change (done), @ollie sanity-check isolation example (done), add small note in CHANGELOG about migration steps.

natalie: pushed the link fix and updated the SLA wording. one more tweak — under "autoscale" examples, add a short table row clarifying when to use prefix caching vs larger min_replicas.

sara: good call, added that. deploy-bot: any remaining checks?

deploy-bot: link-check passed after update. final status: all checks green. ready for review.

ollie: I reviewed, left a tiny comment about phrasing. otherwise LGTM.

sara: thanks! I'll merge after 30m in case anyone else wants to object. :thumbsup:
